title: Full-suite evacuation test fails at base: the child test binary's registry-guard root is left in childTmp by the SIGTERM exit
description:
go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote' (no -short) fails at the base commit 4aa2400c80fd with "the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]". The child is this test binary re-exec'd with TMPDIR=childTmp, so its TestMain's registrytest.GuardMain setup() creates its private temp root ticfac-registry-guard-* inside childTmp; the SIGTERM handler's os.Exit skips GuardMain's RemoveAll, and the parent's ticfacTemp leftover assertion then counts the guard's own root as a run temp tree. The per-tick gate never sees it because the test skips under -short.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding e0bbcf7ab0bfe770adb9830019fb86daf281350116290f2dde342e38baa9280d (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-wcl/attempt-47): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/e0bbcf7ab0bfe770adb9830019fb86daf281350116290f2dde342e38baa9280d.json on the run branch.
